contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP TRAIANO AVG G[ER] DAC PM TR P ; R/ COS V PP SPQR OPTIMO PRINC

Silver Roman coin (denarius) of Trajan (AD 106-111). Diameter: 17.48 mm; Thickness: 2.21 mm; Weight: 3.16g. Mattingly, H and Sydenham, E A Roman Imperial Coinage 1936 Spink [pages: 255-256 vol: II ] Seaby, H A Roman Silver Coins Seaby [pages: 66 ref: No.85]. Obverse inscription: IMP TRAIANO AVG G[ER] DAC PM TR P. Obverse description: Laureate and draped bust right. Reverse inscription: COS V PP SPQR OPTIMO PRINC. Reverse description: Equity standing left, holding scales and cornucopiae
